title: Data for exact integral stratum charts and their normalized cartesian squares
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, and put R = O_E and B_T = lim_n (R/pi^(n+1))_T. Use the integral operations and adic presentation of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-constructible-stratification], [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Define constructible K by sfIntegralConstructible of the existing exact coefficient transport. Define ExactRestriction(f) to retain ordinary module-pullback finite exactness and all-limit preservation, countable ring-product and coefficient-limit preservation, the canonical coefficient projection equations, unique coordinate-normalized strict Roos comparison, invertibility of the derived-limit comparison, the specified integral/completed Comparison, completeness of constructible objects, a natural ordinary/integral comparison normalized by the completion unit, preservation of constructibility, and cohomology comparisons. For h:W→X and q:V→X define chartSquare to be the chosen pullback square; finiteSquare is its canonical finite ringed pullback comparison. Define leftReduction and rightReduction with the actual completed quotient adjuncts and chi. PullbackSquare retains a natural isomorphism of the two chart paths and equality after these reductions with finiteSquare. Define chartMap using the pullback universal property. Model(i,U,K) retains a bounded finite-projective R-complex, an isomorphism from the iterated ordinary chart restriction to its completed constant realization, and inheritance of every cohomological interval. Charts(h,K) retains finite locally closed constructible strata, pro-etale covering families, models, ExactRestriction records on every original and base-changed stratum, object and composite chart map, weak etaleness and covering after base change, Comparison on chart projections and PullbackSquare on every chart. Define withConstructible and Charts.pulledStrata by the existing actual stratification pullback. These are the original data constructors, unchanged.
